cohort: 52 female patients with Grade >=II pelvic-organ prolapse (POP) who were medically fit for general anaesthesia.
finding: Laparoscopic sacrocolpopexy (LSC)/laparoscopic sacrohysteropexy (LSH) is a safe and effective procedure for the treatment of female pelvic-organ prolapse (POP) with high objective (98.1%) and subjective (92.3%) cure rates and low complication rates.
